name: volta-ao-mundo-em-angular
description: Livro aberto e interativo de Angular moderno, do zero ao deploy

scripts.start: npm run snippets && npm start -w site
scripts.build: npm run snippets && npm run build -w site && node scripts/post-build.mjs
scripts.test: npm run snippets && npm test -w site -- --watch=false && node --test 'scripts/**/*.test.mjs'
scripts.check: node scripts/check-contrast.mjs && node scripts/check-output.mjs && node scripts/check-links.mjs
